{{Quote|Look, if you can find a ship on your own I'll see if I can scrape together some of my people to help you crew it. But that really is the best I can do.|The admiral to Lieutenant Judder Page, over the latter's request for resources to track down Moff Kentor Sarne|<ref name="The Saga Begins" />}}
This [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''admiral''' was a member of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]], serving during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], he [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] the [[New Republic task force (Kal'Shebbol)|task force]] that [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberated]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. The planet was ruled by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], a rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who controlled the entire Kathol [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Following the successful liberation of the world, the [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] was ordered to proceed to the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] to rendezvous with forces under the command of [[Sarin Virgilio]], then head on to the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]] to assist Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] in engaging another rogue Imperial warlord. Before he left Kal'Shebbol, the admiral authorized the transfer of personnel and equipment to the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'', which had been charged with [[DarkStryder Campaign|tracking]] down Sarne after the Moff escaped during the battle for his capital.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We've got three days to finish up here before we're supposed to head back to the Minos Cluster, pick up Virgilio's group, and head back in.|The admiral relays Admiral Ackbar's orders for his task force to Lieutenant Judder Page|<ref name="The Saga Begins" />}}
This [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] served in the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], he was placed in [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[New Republic task force (Kal'Shebbol)|task force]] assigned to liberate [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], which was ruled by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who had formed his own empire following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] [[4 ABY/Legends|four years previously]]. Rumors had reached the New Republic that he was in possession of [[DarkStryder technology|exotic weaponry]], and it had been concluded that Sarne's regime had to be eliminated. While a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] raid executed by [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]] was conducted on the planet's surface to disable the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary defense shield]], the admiral led his forces into [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|battle]] against [[Moff Sarne's forces]].<ref name="The Saga Begins" />

Following the successful deactivation of the defense shield, the admiral pressed his advantage and completed the liberation of Kal'Shebbol. Sarne, however, managed to escape with the majority of his forces into the depths of the Kathol [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. With the New Republic in control of the planet, the admiral was contacted by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]], the commander of the commando team that had deactivated the shields. He relayed information to the admiral that the rumors over Sarne's possession of exotic technology were true and requested resources to track Sarne down and neutralize him. The admiral, however, had to deny his request as he could not spare any [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. He had also been ordered to leave Kal'Shebbol in three [[Standard day/Legends|days']] time to rendezvous with [[Sarin Virgilio]]'s forces in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] before heading to the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]] to help Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] box in another rogue Imperial that was terrorizing the region. However, he agreed to provide some personnel for such a mission if Page could find the ship.<ref name="The Saga Begins" />

Page did manage to find a ship&mdash;a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that Sarne had been heavily modifying for his own purposes, which they named the ''[[FarStar]]''. The admiral, keeping his promise, authorized the transfer of personnel and even a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to support the [[DarkStryder Campaign|mission]]. However, Page was still forced to use civilians from Kal'Shebbol to fulfill the crew requirements of the vessel. Three days after the liberation of Kal'Shebbol, the admiral led his force to the Minos Cluster to hook up with Virgilio's forces as per his orders.<ref name="The Saga Begins" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Yes, I've heard all the rumors. If you ask me, the whole story sounds like standard Outer Rim nonsense. Or deliberate Imperial misinformation.|The admiral to Lieutenant Judder Page, over Sarne's possession of exotic new technology|<ref name="The Saga Begins" />}}
A loyal New Republic officer, this admiral was a competent commander and combat officer. He kept his word, transferring personnel and supplies from his task force to support the ''FarStar''{{'s}} mission after promising to do so if Page could supply a ship for the mission. While he understood Page's need to go after Moff Sarne, he was dismissive of the claims that the warlord possessed exotic technology, writing it off as nonsense or deliberate misinformation.<ref name="The Saga Begins" />

==Behind the scenes==
This admiral was briefly featured in the short story ''[[The Saga Begins]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' by [[West End Games]]. The admiral is never seen, but does have a conversation with Lieutenant Judder Page during the story by communicator.<ref name="The Saga Begins" />
